C08-M01-L07-F1.title: Where SOC speed metrics start and stop
C08-M01-L07-F1.caption: The five moments on an incident timeline that MTTD, MTTA, time to contain and MTTR are measured between.
C08-M01-L07-F1.alt: Flow diagram of five steps in time order: Malicious activity begins (earliest evidence, often found later); Alert or case created (MTTD stops; MTTA and MTTR start); Analyst acknowledges (MTTA stops: someone owns it); Threat contained (time to contain stops); Case resolved and closed (MTTR stops, as in soc_metrics.py).

steps.label: Alert or case created
steps.sub: MTTD stops; MTTA and MTTR start

C08-M01-L07-F1.note: A metric is an interval between two defined timestamps: write down both ends and record them in UTC.

C08-M01-L07-F2.title: Mean versus median MTTA in soc_metrics.py
C08-M01-L07-F2.caption: The five acknowledgement times from the lab script and the two summaries it prints: one late true positive inflates the mean.
C08-M01-L07-F2.alt: Bar chart of acknowledgement times in minutes: 06:15 TP 5, 07:00 FP 2, 08:20 FP 1, 09:00 TP 150 (highlighted red), 10:00 BTP 4, then Median MTTA 4.0 in green and Mean MTTA 32.4 in orange.
C08-M01-L07-F2.note: Real output: MTTA mean 32.4 min, median 4.0 min. The outlier was a true positive that waited 150 minutes.
